sentence: This project studies how the viscosity, wetting, and drying of perovskite inks control film formation and how well the resulting devices work.
This project builds a device that records and controls the electrical, chemical, and optical activity of brain circuits.
This project studies how to keep private information safe in wireless networks and how to guard against attacks such as eavesdropping.
This project builds methods that use smart meter data to model electric power distribution grids and detect large-scale outages.
This project studies how the solutions of partial differential equations behave near singularities and how spheres, cones, and cylinders appear in them.
This project builds a curriculum about drones that covers piloting, mission design, maintenance, and cybersecurity.
This project builds a learning framework that uses deep neural networks to model complex physical systems from physical laws and noisy data.
This project studies how peptoids, a class of synthetic molecules, can degrade in response to reactive radicals but not to enzymes.
This project studies how irrigation and water restrictions change the movement of water through soils, plants, and the air in cities.
This project develops design tools that account for the physical limits of memristor chips, reducing the reliance on costly on-chip training.
This project designs immersive learning experiences in Minecraft that build spatial computational thinking skills through visual programming.
This project tests whether software that combines knowledge graphs and neural networks can find why manufacturing defects happen and recommend corrective actions.
This project studies why some social experiences have lasting effects on behavior and gene activity in the honey bee brain.
This project creates methods to model, estimate, and control the movement of legged robots so they stay stable on surfaces that move.
This project studies how mountain forests responded to past environmental changes by analyzing sediments.
